qualification: Actual production BrowserCookieImport, BrowserVault and SafariAccessOnboarding with production CSS/theme. Both complete author canonical browser files run unchanged except additive read-only observations and the real useTheme setup with a controlled desktop theme acknowledgement. Original native API/Safari replies and synthetic credentials remain fixtures; no installed-browser detection, Keychain, native cookie transfer or durable Electron session is exercised. The first-run information sheet remains an interim feature, not the unfinished direct onboarding importer.

dialog.text: Bring your Safari logins along?Synara's browser can pick up sites you're already signed into in Safari, so you don't have to log in twice. It's optional, and nothing is copied until you ask.1Open System Settings › Privacy & Security › Full Disk Access.2Switch on Synara (Dev). Not listed? Show app in Finder and drag it in.3Quit and reopen Synara.Full Disk Access is a broad macOS permission that reaches beyond Safari. If you'd rather not, that's fine. You can find this again under Settings › General.Not nowOpen System Settings
